# AmberCell

> High-interaction honeypot: real open-source daemons in sealed cells, packet-level evidence, one-way dead drop. Zero emulation.

AmberCell is a single-host deception system for security research and defensive operations. It runs genuine network services (not scripted banners) inside per-protocol cells behind host nftables, records pcap / flows / JSONL via collectors, and publishes intelligence through a one-way dead drop that SIEMs pull — never the other way around.

## Key facts

- Interaction level: high (real OSS daemons)
- Deployment: Docker Compose + amberctl on Linux
- Containment: nftables DNAT, egress allowlists, DNS sinkhole
- Evidence: collector-owned netns → /var/ambercell (pcap, JSONL, flows)
- Exfiltration path: one-way dead drop only
- Production gates: kill bars G1–G14
- Maintainers: Cyber Halluci Net (CHN)
